method: Deterministic swept-circle edge contracts, not played missions or visible-body art validation.
checks: swept body entry wins over large steps and array order
off-axis and tangent misses keep full travel
oblique entry ends outside the padded body
dead, unknown, covered and vertically clear bodies do not brake
escaping an existing overlap works; continuing into it stops without a push
sideways and retreating routes preserve distance; non-touch behavior is untouched
